summary.en: Action hierarchy, size, loading and duplicate submission
summary.zh-CN: 动作层级、尺寸、加载与重复提交

native.en: widgets.Button / widgets.button; the basic action contract can be mapped, and host events use widgets.Action.
native.zh-CN: widgets.Button / widgets.button；基础动作契约可对应，宿主事件使用 widgets.Action。

summary.en: Labels, help, errors and input recovery
summary.zh-CN: 标签、帮助、错误、只读与输入恢复

native.en: widgets.Editor / widgets.input / widgets.text_area; native IME, selection and clipboard are handled by the host.
native.zh-CN: widgets.Editor / widgets.input / widgets.text_area；原生 IME、选区与剪贴板由宿主处理。

summary.zh-CN: 状态文字、通知、等待与确认

native.en: Cross-host interaction principles; this library's browser dialog does not mean that native hosts already provide an API of the same name.
native.zh-CN: 跨宿主交互原则；此库的浏览器 dialog 不等于原生宿主已经提供同名 API。

summary.en: Opening, arrow keys, disabled entries and closing
summary.zh-CN: 展开、方向键、禁用项与退出

native.en: Native widgets.Menu and ui.MenuEntry both provide menu capabilities; hierarchy, shortcuts and the host menu bar need separate adaptation.
native.zh-CN: 原生 widgets.Menu 与 ui.MenuEntry 均有菜单能力；层级、快捷键和宿主菜单栏需要单独适配。

summary.en: Selection, arrow keys and linked panels
summary.zh-CN: 选中关系、方向键与关联面板

native.en: Where a native tab control exists, adapt it to the host focus model; this library only commits to this Web automatic-activation pattern.
native.zh-CN: 有原生页签控件时按宿主焦点模型适配；本库只承诺此 Web 自动激活模式。

summary.en: Sorting, pagination, empty results and action names
summary.zh-CN: 排序、分页、空结果和操作名称

native.en: widgets.Table supports native tables and sorting; pagination belongs to the application data model and is not claimed to be provided automatically by the host.
native.zh-CN: widgets.Table 支持原生表格与排序；分页属于应用数据模型，不声称由宿主自动提供。

summary.zh-CN: 展开层级、选中项目与可见项导航

native.en: Native Tree capabilities must be verified against the actual SDK interface; this Web tree uses the WAI-ARIA tree model.
native.zh-CN: 原生 Tree 能力需要对照实际 SDK 接口验证；此 Web 树使用 WAI-ARIA tree 模型。

summary.en: Constrained panel sizes and keyboard adjustment
summary.zh-CN: 受约束的面板尺寸与键盘调整

native.en: Native split layouts are adapted to host size constraints; Web pointer capture and the DOM separator must not be treated directly as a native implementation.
native.zh-CN: 原生分割布局按宿主尺寸约束适配；Web 指针捕获与 DOM separator 不能直接当作原生实现。

summary.en: 2D canvas primitives, series toggling, keyboard point inspection and chart types
summary.zh-CN: 2D 画布图元、序列显隐、键盘数据点检视与图表类型切换

native.en: draw.Frame / draw.Path / draw.Surface / widgets.Chart; native XDF1 frames and CTM/layer stacks are verified by the host.
native.zh-CN: draw.Frame / draw.Path / draw.Surface / widgets.Chart；原生 XDF1 帧记录与 CTM／图层栈由宿主校验执行。
